facts.fact: The Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843) is the current law, under which processing personal data without registering with the commission is an offence carrying two years in prison, and it is undergoing review, per the commission's executive director.
The Data Protection Commission, led by executive director Dr Arnold Kavaarpuo, is acting under the Act.
The commission's executive director said it registered more entities in September 2026 than in all its previous years, focusing on the public sector first.
